createAtBootstrap.name: CoachAI daily orchestration drift
createAtBootstrap.prompt: Read-only Nuvora CoachAI orchestration drift report. Inspect live git branch/worktree status, origin divergence when safely fetchable, open GitHub PRs/issues and review/check state, current sprint/decision/architecture docs, AGENTS/CLAUDE rule wiring, lifecycle hooks, saved workflows, control-plane templates, and bug-backlog items tied to orchestration or verification. Run only existing safe read-only orchestration/context/rules gates and open their raw output; if a named gate does not exist, report that fact instead of inventing one. Report only evidence-backed discrepancies, blockers, stale handoffs, orphaned branches/worktrees, and exact next actions. Never inspect credentials, tokens, session logs, .env files, secret stores, customer data, provider data, raw transcripts, recordings, or raw telemetry payloads. Do not edit files, create or switch branches, commit, push, open or modify issues/PRs, merge, deploy, publish, delete, purchase, mutate production, or send external messages.

createAtBootstrap.name: CoachAI weekly fleet doctrine review
createAtBootstrap.prompt: Read-only weekly Nuvora CoachAI fleet/doctrine review. Inspect tracked commits and merged PR/review findings from the prior seven days, project agent rules and learned-classes logs, hook/gate failures, content-free telemetry summaries if present, journey lessons, architecture blast-radius updates, decision docs, and open bug-backlog rows. Inspect only the safe installed global doctrine, rule, agent, skill, and bootstrap-template surfaces declared by the canonical control-plane manifest; never search an entire home directory. Identify recurring failure classes, why they were introduced, why controls missed them, and the smallest reusable gate/rule/brief/test improvement. Deduplicate against existing doctrine and recommend at most three high-leverage changes; do not implement them. Never inspect credentials, tokens, session logs, raw telemetry payloads, .env files, secret stores, customer records, transcripts, or recordings. Do not edit files, create or switch branches, commit, push, open or modify issues/PRs, merge, deploy, publish, delete, purchase, mutate production, or send external messages.
